"title": "Visual e2e: manage Clerk test users with Playwright fixtures",

"body": "## Problem

Visual Playwright specs create ephemeral Clerk `+clerk_test` users (`codetail+{timestamp}-{label}-clerk_test@example.com`, `private_metadata.createdBy: e2e-visual-admin`) during seed/`beforeAll`, but **Docker/CI deliberately skips Clerk teardown**.

`shouldResetVisualSeeds()` in `e2e/visual/_helpers.ts` returns `false` when `VISUAL_DOCKER=1` or `CI` is set, so every `afterAll` that calls `deleteClerkTestUser` / `resetAdminClerkUsers` / `resetHostClerkUsers` is a no-op in the canonical runner.

Over repeated Visual CI runs this fills the Clerk free-tier user quota and fails user creation (`createClerkTestUser`), which recently blocked CI until users were batch-deleted by hand.

Convex seed state can stay disposable under anonymous local Convex; **Clerk users are not disposable** — they live on the shared Clerk instance.

## Goal

Implement Clerk (and related) user **setup + cleanup with Playwright fixtures** so teardown always runs for Clerk users — including Docker/CI — without relying on per-spec `beforeAll`/`afterAll` that opt out via `shouldResetVisualSeeds()`.

## Proposed approach

1. **Playwright fixture(s)** (worker- or test-scoped) that:
   - create labeled `+clerk_test` users (reuse `createClerkTestUser` / `VISUAL_ADMIN_CLERK_MARKER`)
   - expose `{ userId, email, … }` to the test/seed
   - **always** `deleteClerkTestUser` in fixture teardown (`finally`), independent of `shouldResetVisualSeeds()`
2. Prefer fixture-owned lifecycle over duplicated `afterAll` cleanup in each of:
   - `e2e/visual/admin.spec.ts`
   - `e2e/visual/host.spec.ts`
   - `e2e/visual/player.spec.ts`
   - `e2e/visual/solo-play.spec.ts`
   - `e2e/visual/ingest.spec.ts`
   - `e2e/visual/chrome.spec.ts`
3. Keep Convex DB reset skippable in Docker/CI (anonymous deploy is ephemeral); **do not** skip Clerk user deletion.
4. Optional hardening:
   - worker-scoped shared users where safe (fewer creates)
   - `globalTeardown` / safety-net sweep of `createdBy: e2e-visual-admin` older than N minutes if a run is killed mid-suite
   - fail fast with a clear quota error if create returns Clerk capacity errors

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Clerk test users created for visual specs are deleted after the suite/worker finishes in **local host**, **Docker**, and **CI**
- [ ] `shouldResetVisualSeeds()` no longer gates Clerk deletion (Convex-only concern)
- [ ] Repeated `pnpm test:visual:docker` / Visual workflow runs do not accumulate `codetail+*-clerk_test@example.com` users
- [ ] Specs use fixtures instead of ad-hoc create/delete where practical; existing seed helpers can still create users if fixtures own teardown
- [ ] Documented in `e2e/README.md`

## Context / refs

- Recent quota incident: batch-deleted 96 leftover visual users to unblock CI
- Create/delete helpers: `e2e/seed/_clerk-auth.ts`
- Skip flag: `e2e/visual/_helpers.ts` → `shouldResetVisualSeeds()`
- Docs today: `e2e/README.md` (“Docker / CI … skips afterAll seed + Clerk teardown”)

"title": "Multi-browser living-room E2E: host + remote + TV + 2 players",

"body": "## Summary

Add a **full Playwright multi-browser E2E** that plays through a real multiplayer game with four concurrent clients:

| Role | Browser context | Surface |
|---|---|---|
| Host | Chromium A (signed-in Clerk) | `/game/host/$gameId` (classic and/or Remote shell when TV connected) |
| TV | Chromium B (unauthenticated) | `/game/tv/$gameId` |
| Player 1 | Chromium C (player session) | `/game/$code` join → player round UI |
| Player 2 | Chromium D (player session) | same |
| Remote (optional 5th, or reuse host-as-remote) | Chromium E or host tab | `/r/$token` public Remote |

Goal: catch integration bugs that single-surface visual goldens cannot — pairing, presence, break mode, audible authority, round progression, and cross-client sync — in one scripted living-room night.

Related: [#92](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/92) (TV), [#94](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/94) (Remote), [#97](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/97) (WebRTC media room / presence).

## Why

Today `e2e/visual/*` seeds Convex state and screenshots **one surface at a time**. That is excellent for CSS/layout, but it does not prove:

- TV heartbeat / `tvConnected` flips host UI (Remote shell, mute)
- Players can join via code/QR while TV lobby is up
- Host/Remote actions advance rounds that players and TV observe
- Break mode pauses TV audio and blocks round mutations
- Closing TV returns usable host audio (once #97 lands: peer disconnect; today: heartbeat TTL)
- Remote token auth works from a public `/r/$token` page without Clerk

A multi-context Playwright suite is the right place for that contract.

## Scope (happy path — one full round minimum)

### Setup

1. Seed or create: host Clerk user, set with enough songs for ≥1 round, create game (or use `seedHost` + live mutations).
2. Open **four** browser contexts in one test (serial, single worker):
   - Host (Clerk)
   - TV (`game.tvPath`)
   - Player Alex + Player Blair (join by code; inject or complete join UI)

Optional fifth: public Remote via `game.remotePath` (if host stays classic, or after host prefers classic).

### Flow to automate

1. **Lobby**
   - TV shows join code / QR
   - Both players join and appear on host + TV roster
   - Host starts game
2. **Round playing**
   - TV shows listening stage; host/remote can skip or wait for placement
   - At least one player places a guess (or host drives to resolving via existing host actions if player place is flaky under stubs)
3. **Reveal / award**
   - Host/Remote reveals and awards
   - TV shows reveal + standings (transport controls must not block scores)
4. **Break (if shipped)**
   - Host/Remote enters break → TV scoreboard + join QR; round mutations rejected
   - Resume → continue
5. **TV disconnect**
   - Close TV context → host becomes / stays operable (mute off when TV gone; Remote shell may leave)
6. **Finish**
   - End or complete enough rounds to reach a stable finished/between state and assert key UI on remaining clients

YouTube: reuse `installYouTubeIframeApiStub` / thumbnail stubs so CI does not depend on real YouTube.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)

- [ ] New Playwright spec (e.g. `e2e/live/living-room.spec.ts` or `e2e/e2e/living-room.spec.ts`) runs **multiple browser contexts** in one test
- [ ] Covers host + TV + ≥2 distinct player sessions through lobby → in-round → reveal/award
- [ ] Asserts cross-client visibility (player join reflected on host/TV; host action reflected on players/TV)
- [ ] Includes Remote **or** host-as-remote path with TV connected (mute / shell behavior)
- [ ] Exercises break enter/resume if break mode remains in product
- [ ] Exercises TV tab close → host continues
- [ ] Uses Clerk test users + Convex local (same Docker visual harness or a sibling Compose target)
- [ ] Deterministic under YouTube stubs; no reliance on real network media
- [ ] Documented how to run locally / in CI (`pnpm test:…`); not required to be a screenshot golden suite (assertions > pixels)
- [ ] Flake budget: retries allowed, but root-cause sleeps/races called out in the PR

## Non-goals

- Replacing the visual golden matrix
- Perfect A/V sync timing assertions (until #97); assert commands/UI state instead
- Load / stress testing many concurrent games

## Implementation notes

- Prefer Playwright `browser.newContext()` × N over separate projects so one test owns the whole night
- Worker-scoped Clerk host via `extendClerkUsers`; players via session seed / join UI
- Reuse `e2e/seed/host.ts` paths (`hostPath`, `tvPath`, `remotePath`, `code`) where possible; may need “live” mutations mid-test instead of fully pre-seeded round states
- Keep suite **serial** and isolated (unique host subject / reset) to avoid seed races already fixed on this branch
- Gate in CI behind the existing visual Docker job or a dedicated `e2e-live` job with the same Clerk secrets

## Open questions

- Minimum bar: one round vs full game-to-finished?
- Is public `/r/$token` required in v1, or is host-as-remote + TV enough?
- Should this run on every PR or nightly (runtime / flake cost)?",

"title": "[Cursor] Add PostHog for field Web Vitals / INP",

"body": "## Summary

Landing Lighthouse is a cold-load lab for `/`. Players spend the session on `/game/$code` (steal, place, timeline). We need field INP, not another synthetic homepage score.

PostHog's free cloud plan includes 1M events/month. `$web_vitals` covers LCP, INP, CLS, FCP as normal events (~30% of pageviews). That is enough for Codetail traffic and gives a real dashboard without a paid RUM vendor.

Netlify RUM is Pro-only. CrUX / Search Console will not see per-game URLs and lag by ~28 days.

## Scope

- PostHog JS on production (not e2e / local unless flagged)
- Enable web vitals capture; keep product autocapture off unless we decide we want it
- Report **route templates** (`/game/$code`), never raw join codes
- Filter or sample so `$web_vitals` does not drown the free quota if we later add more events

Nice-to-have: INP grouped by path so player vs landing vs host/TV are visible.

## Out of scope

- Session replay (free quota is tiny; skip)
- Cloudflare beacon / DIY `web-vitals` → Convex (alternatives if PostHog is too heavy)
- Host/TV YouTube iframe metrics

## Test plan

- [ ] Production pageviews show `$web_vitals` with INP
- [ ] `/game/$code` appears as a template, not individual codes
- [ ] No PostHog in Playwright / Docker e2e
- [ ] Clerk / session tokens never sent as properties

Posted by Cursor Grok 4.6",

- Capture field `$web_vitals` (INP, LCP, CLS, FCP) on production, grouped by route templates like `/game/$code` instead of raw join URLs.

- Local and Playwright/Docker stay off unless `VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_ENABLED=true`. Netlify already has the project token on production, deploy-preview, and branch-deploy.

- [ ] Public `/ingest/$id` still loads
- [ ] Playwright / Docker e2e do not load PostHog

"body": "### Join codes leak into PostHog events **Medium Severity** `sanitizeCaptureEvent` rewrites URL and path properties and drops `data-code`, but it never scrubs `$title`, `$prev_pageview_title`, or autocapture `$el_text` / `$elements` text. The player route title embeds the join code, and the host copy-link control still renders the raw join URL without `ph-no-capture` (`JoinCodeBadge` is also unprotected). Every `/game/$code` pageview and those clicks therefore send the live code as event properties, which this change set out to prevent.
Additional Locations (2) - [`src/components/game/HostLobby.tsx#L81-L103`](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/blob/826d5be2b223ba79b3bd4888bd68ebffaaf47623/src/components/game/HostLobby.tsx#L81-L103) - [`src/routes/game/$code.tsx#L20-L25`](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/blob/826d5be2b223ba79b3bd4888bd68ebffaaf47623/src/routes/game/$code.tsx#L20-L25)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 826d5be2b223ba79b3bd4888bd68ebffaaf47623. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot). ",

"body": "Fixed in 7218fca. `before_send` now redacts live route params in `$title`, `$el_text`, and related strings (`Game ABC12` → `Game $code`). The host copy-link control and `JoinCodeBadge` are `ph-no-capture`. Also stopped exporting `sanitizeCaptureEvent` so knip is clean.\n\nPosted by Cursor Grok 4.6",

"body": "### Join codes leak on host routes **Medium Severity** `redactText` only substitutes params found in known pathnames, so a bare join code on `/game/host/$gameId` or `/game/tv/$gameId` is left intact. Autocapture still walks ancestors, and those nodes' `$el_text` / `$elements_chain` include the lobby code. `ph-no-capture` on the code node does not strip that ancestor text, so join codes can still reach PostHog.
Additional Locations (1) - [`src/lib/analytics/routeTemplate.ts#L44-L59`](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/blob/7218fcaf160cb89e3234f6d247cafaddf9941948/src/lib/analytics/routeTemplate.ts#L44-L59)

+{
+  "html_url": "https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/98",
+  "number": 98,
+  "title": "Multi-browser living-room E2E: host + remote + TV + 2 players",
+  "body": "## Summary

Add a **full Playwright multi-browser E2E** that plays through a real multiplayer game with four concurrent clients:

| Role | Browser context | Surface |
|---|---|---|
| Host | Chromium A (signed-in Clerk) | `/game/host/$gameId` (classic and/or Remote shell when TV connected) |
| TV | Chromium B (unauthenticated) | `/game/tv/$gameId` |
| Player 1 | Chromium C (player session) | `/game/$code` join → player round UI |
| Player 2 | Chromium D (player session) | same |
| Remote (optional 5th, or reuse host-as-remote) | Chromium E or host tab | `/r/$token` public Remote |

Goal: catch integration bugs that single-surface visual goldens cannot — pairing, presence, break mode, audible authority, round progression, and cross-client sync — in one scripted living-room night.

Related: [#92](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/92) (TV), [#94](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/94) (Remote), [#97](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/97) (WebRTC media room / presence).

## Why

Today `e2e/visual/*` seeds Convex state and screenshots **one surface at a time**. That is excellent for CSS/layout, but it does not prove:

- TV heartbeat / `tvConnected` flips host UI (Remote shell, mute)
- Players can join via code/QR while TV lobby is up
- Host/Remote actions advance rounds that players and TV observe
- Break mode pauses TV audio and blocks round mutations
- Closing TV returns usable host audio (once #97 lands: peer disconnect; today: heartbeat TTL)
- Remote token auth works from a public `/r/$token` page without Clerk

A multi-context Playwright suite is the right place for that contract.

## Scope (happy path — one full round minimum)

### Setup

1. Seed or create: host Clerk user, set with enough songs for ≥1 round, create game (or use `seedHost` + live mutations).
2. Open **four** browser contexts in one test (serial, single worker):
   - Host (Clerk)
   - TV (`game.tvPath`)
   - Player Alex + Player Blair (join by code; inject or complete join UI)

Optional fifth: public Remote via `game.remotePath` (if host stays classic, or after host prefers classic).

### Flow to automate

1. **Lobby**
   - TV shows join code / QR
   - Both players join and appear on host + TV roster
   - Host starts game
2. **Round playing**
   - TV shows listening stage; host/remote can skip or wait for placement
   - At least one player places a guess (or host drives to resolving via existing host actions if player place is flaky under stubs)
3. **Reveal / award**
   - Host/Remote reveals and awards
   - TV shows reveal + standings (transport controls must not block scores)
4. **Break (if shipped)**
   - Host/Remote enters break → TV scoreboard + join QR; round mutations rejected
   - Resume → continue
5. **TV disconnect**
   - Close TV context → host becomes / stays operable (mute off when TV gone; Remote shell may leave)
6. **Finish**
   - End or complete enough rounds to reach a stable finished/between state and assert key UI on remaining clients

YouTube: reuse `installYouTubeIframeApiStub` / thumbnail stubs so CI does not depend on real YouTube.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)

- [ ] New Playwright spec (e.g. `e2e/live/living-room.spec.ts` or `e2e/e2e/living-room.spec.ts`) runs **multiple browser contexts** in one test
- [ ] Covers host + TV + ≥2 distinct player sessions through lobby → in-round → reveal/award
- [ ] Asserts cross-client visibility (player join reflected on host/TV; host action reflected on players/TV)
- [ ] Includes Remote **or** host-as-remote path with TV connected (mute / shell behavior)
- [ ] Exercises break enter/resume if break mode remains in product
- [ ] Exercises TV tab close → host continues
- [ ] Uses Clerk test users + Convex local (same Docker visual harness or a sibling Compose target)
- [ ] Deterministic under YouTube stubs; no reliance on real network media
- [ ] Documented how to run locally / in CI (`pnpm test:…`); not required to be a screenshot golden suite (assertions > pixels)
- [ ] Flake budget: retries allowed, but root-cause sleeps/races called out in the PR

## Non-goals

- Replacing the visual golden matrix
- Perfect A/V sync timing assertions (until #97); assert commands/UI state instead
- Load / stress testing many concurrent games

## Implementation notes

- Prefer Playwright `browser.newContext()` × N over separate projects so one test owns the whole night
- Worker-scoped Clerk host via `extendClerkUsers`; players via session seed / join UI
- Reuse `e2e/seed/host.ts` paths (`hostPath`, `tvPath`, `remotePath`, `code`) where possible; may need “live” mutations mid-test instead of fully pre-seeded round states
- Keep suite **serial** and isolated (unique host subject / reset) to avoid seed races already fixed on this branch
- Gate in CI behind the existing visual Docker job or a dedicated `e2e-live` job with the same Clerk secrets

## Open questions

- Minimum bar: one round vs full game-to-finished?
- Is public `/r/$token` required in v1, or is host-as-remote + TV enough?
- Should this run on every PR or nightly (runtime / flake cost)?",

+  "user": {
+    "login": "matemolnar8"
+  }
+}

- [ ] Covers host + TV + ≥2 distinct player sessions through lobby → in-round → reveal/award
- [ ] Asserts cross-client visibility (player join reflected on host/TV; host action reflected on players/TV)
- [ ] Includes Remote **or** host-as-remote path with TV connected (mute / shell behavior)
- [ ] Exercises break enter/resume if break mode remains in product
- [ ] Exercises TV tab close → host continues
- [ ] Uses Clerk test users + Convex local (same Docker visual harness or a sibling Compose target)
- [ ] Deterministic under YouTube stubs; no reliance on real network media
- [ ] Documented how to run locally / in CI (`pnpm test:…`); not required to be a screenshot golden suite (assertions > pixels)
- [ ] Flake budget: retries allowed, but root-cause sleeps/races called out in the PR

## Non-goals

- Replacing the visual golden matrix
- Perfect A/V sync timing assertions (until #97); assert commands/UI state instead
- Load / stress testing many concurrent games

## Implementation notes

- Prefer Playwright `browser.newContext()` × N over separate projects so one test owns the whole night
- Worker-scoped Clerk host via `extendClerkUsers`; players via session seed / join UI
- Reuse `e2e/seed/host.ts` paths (`hostPath`, `tvPath`, `remotePath`, `code`) where possible; may need “live” mutations mid-test instead of fully pre-seeded round states
- Keep suite **serial** and isolated (unique host subject / reset) to avoid seed races already fixed on this branch
- Gate in CI behind the existing visual Docker job or a dedicated `e2e-live` job with the same Clerk secrets

## Open questions

- Minimum bar: one round vs full game-to-finished?
- Is public `/r/$token` required in v1, or is host-as-remote + TV enough?
- Should this run on every PR or nightly (runtime / flake cost)?",

"body": "## Summary

- [ ] Public `/ingest/$id` still loads
- [ ] Playwright / Docker e2e do not load PostHog
- [ ] Clerk / session tokens and join codes never show up as event properties
